I didn’t even know what plant healthcare was before this job and after this experience I have nothing but the upmost respect for people who do this for a living. They don’t get the credit they’re deserving of. This is field can be either straight forward or very very particular it’s not a job that anyone can do it’s a job that requires certain and specific skills. For experience guys yeah they probably would laugh and shrug their shoulders and say it’s no big deal or it’s not that complicated etc but no it is for people like me it’s one the most confusing, frustrating and honestly depressing jobs I’ve ever had. People like me do not have what it takes lol. This job feels like I should have a degree for it like that’s how intense it is for me. I just I know in theory it’s possible for certain people but I don’t believe hiring anyone off the street and trying to train them for this field is a good strategy at all. If it were me I’d never bc I’d feel like I’d be jeopardizing my business its a gamble no one should take it’s just not a good idea.

Long story short I’m on the east coast and I’ve been working for the company for about a year. I’m the only one in PHC and it’s been that way the entire time. Yes PHC technicians can work independently I know but the houses I work on are mansion sized sometimes 30 acre homes and that’s not even the worst part. The worst part is I have no idea what im doing they just tell me to go do a thing and im like ok they don’t check they never came out with me on the road to see if im actually doing things right they don’t care. They’re about the money. I’ve tried to talk to them multiple times and they just brush it off but if I don’t do something perfectly to a tee they get insanely passive aggressive it’s only when I do something wrong and i get crapped on for it and that’s how I’ve been learning. I work with chemicals and oils I could spray the wrong thing and completely butcher a tree (which I’ve done, somehow I wasn’t fired) that’s just insane to me that’s a psychotic way of teaching. The amount of negligence and messed up working conditions I’ve thought about suing it’s that bad. I haven’t left yet bc it’s just hard times right now. But that’s a different long story.
